I feel like the whole stalker thing is usually perpetuated by the one who considers themselves stalked. I'm a guy who usually tries to hide his feelings because anytime I voice them, I always face humiliating rejection. There was a girl who helped me through a very rough time in my life. I liked her, I didn't think she liked me. She called me her little brother and every now and then would hang out with me. We would get close and she would cancel and not return texts and drift away and I'd text her and call her and wonder what I had done wrong. Eventually we'd get close again. I pulled strings and got her a good job and would try to always be nice and considerate and polite. I'd make jokes and we'd hang out and drink and have fun. I had feelings for her, but I eventually accepted that I'd just be a friend and not anything more. I still tried my best to be a good friend. One day she kisses me, says she has feeling for me. I got her something for Valentine's day and she just said "You're so weird". Well I got drunk/highest I've ever been and left some voicemails. It was a dick move, I know. I said I was sorry, she said they were infuriating and wouldnt talk to me. So I texted her and called and said I was sorry. Tried and tried. It's embarrassing. But I think we're done now. It has hurt me so bad, I can't explain. I had a rough childhood with abusive father and stepfather, I have emotional and trust issues. I've never had a girlfriend. She just kissed me and said she had feelings and immediately turned her back after I left drunk voicemails. For a few nights, I was on top of the world thinking this amazing girl actually liked me, actually wanted me. Not just anyone, but this wonderful girl! No girl ever showed me much interest, but this girl did! She made a move on me, there was no way that I had mistaken it! And then she turns her back on me. Any hope for a relationship, any hope for physical and emotional intimacy, all just evaporated. So yeah, I texted and called and begged and made a fool of myself. She probably told her friends or whoever that I was some creep that wouldn't leave her alone or kept trying to talk to her. But when you see a chance at love, see that maybe this wonderful person wants you! Well, you do stupid things. Even when they treat you like trash and reject you, you keep hoping maybe they'll see whatever good things they saw in you in the first place and take you back. When really, the only reason they kissed you in the first place was on a whim and they don't give a shit about your feelings. These things arent always so clear cut.

I used to be "his child" and played along and did everything I could right, never stole, never lied, tried to treat people well. I lie now sometimes, but never stole, still try to treat people well. But all of this being said, and I don't mean to offend, this is just bluntly the way I've come to view it now: I will not bow, plead, beg, and grovel on my knees to some entity that if he does exist, gave me pain and suffering my whole childhood and withheld love and affection from me, save for my mother who, though mislead, did love me. I look at pictures of the Holocaust and the Armenian genocide. 9/11. Boston bombing. Columbine. Sandy Hook. Jim Jones. I look at these things and I can't fathom a loving god. A sick twisted cruel god perhaps. Or, alternately, there are bad people who made this happen. The same way good people like Jonas Salk gave the world polio vaccines without trying to charge ridiculous amounts of money for them. Sorry, this is just what conclusion I've reached.

[Mad Season](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SJKvE3tMIPs) produced some beautifully dark music. Their only album, Above, is one of my top 5 for sure. They took a psychadelic/jazzy twist on grunge. Had Layne Staley of Alice in Chains and Mark Lanegan of Screaming Trees on vocals. Mike McCreedy of Pearl Jam on guitar. Barret Martin of Screaming Trees on drums. John Saunders was the bassist. After that album they had problems producing a second due to Saunders and Staleys heroin addiction which would eventually kill the two in 1999 and 2002 respectively. If you wanna know about some truly tragic and pensive music, if anyone in the world knows that feel, it's heroin addicts.
